subject.title: Tracking: cross-process orphan-sweep TOCTOU in provider Cleanup paths (apple-container / local-container / external)

question: Does the guarded candidate-snapshot pattern provide sufficient ownership protection for each provider without weakening legitimate orphan cleanup?
rationale: The issue concerns destructive provider cleanup and healthy lease ownership; maintainers must confirm the provider-specific security boundary and cleanup semantics before merging each fix.

options.title: Review provider fixes separately
options.body: Apply the established conditional-removal pattern in each provider and merge only after focused concurrency tests confirm both protection and legitimate orphan deletion.

options.title: Require a broader cleanup lock
options.body: Pause the provider-specific fixes and design a shared cross-process serialization mechanism if conditional claim checks are considered insufficient.

recommendation.title: Review provider fixes separately
recommendation.body: Apply the established conditional-removal pattern in each provider and merge only after focused concurrency tests confirm both protection and legitimate orphan deletion.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history is the prior merged ownership-proof and provider-mutation hardening work.
